brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases (piece:-1,0,0; piece:0,0,0; piece:1,0,0) in a straight row at level 0. check_build reports meshClash 'clear' and no rule errors.
Two drawer-frame notches (notch:0#0,1#notch1 'hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm' and notch:0#0,-1#notch4 'hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf'), each seated in an empty spot beside the touching bases.

requirements.requirement: One of the drawers shown pulled open
requirements.evidence: setNotchOpen applied open:true to the notch at (0,1) k=1; the notch at (0,-1) k=4 was left closed.

requirements.requirement: Material, strength, fit of the printed drawers
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks fit and collisions only; no material or load properties were assessed.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
